description: Recorded reasons for shipped or staged items whose licence could not be established from shipped metadata. This file gates nothing (docs/decisions.md P-09): each item is listed in the notices and flagged 'unverified' (or, for a font with no record in font-licenses.json, 'proprietary-no-licence-recorded') whether or not it has an entry here, and the reason below is printed as its obligation note. A reason is a record, not legal sign-off. A font entry carries the exact file hash; scripts/font-license-blockers.mjs reports a payload file with those bytes as an unresolved font. An entry with `requires` names the record that ships the item; it is reported as stale only once that record exists.

entries.name: elizaOS voice runtime sources (Paradee graph, kokoro layers, eliza-inference FFI, elizavoice-jni) in libelizainference
entries.reason: These sources are compiled into libelizainference from the elizaOS llama.cpp fork at the forkPin recorded in android/voice-host/qualified-voice-host.json (tools/paradee, tools/kokoro, tools/misaki-g2p, tools/omnivoice) and the elizavoice-jni bridge from the pinned elizaOS/eliza source. elizaOS is MIT, but the fork vendors third-party voice code whose per-file licences are not enumerated by the voice host record. Flagged, not blocking.

entries.name: On-device elizaOS agent runtime payload
entries.reason: The staged runtime can ship in standard Android builds. When it is staged, Bun and the bundled agent and workflow-worker npm packages are enumerated from the prepared source; the remaining payload files (musl loader, libstdc++/libgcc_s, PGlite WebAssembly and data, PostgreSQL extensions, models) are not.

entries.name: pdf.js QuickJS sandbox
entries.reason: pdfjs-dist ships quickjs-eval.js/.wasm without a license file. The upstream sandbox build and QuickJS itself are believed to be permissively licensed, but no shipped license text establishes it.
